G3000.def: from latris (a hired menial); to minister (to God), i.e. render religious homage:--serve, do the service, worship(-per).

G3002.def: of uncertain origin; Lebbaeus, a Christian:--Lebbaeus.

G3003.def: of Latin origin; a "legion", i.e. Roman regiment (figuratively):--legion.

G3004.def: a primary verb; properly, to "lay" forth, i.e. (figuratively) relate (in words (usually of systematic or set discourse; whereas «2036» and «5346» generally refer to an individual expression or speech respectively; while «4483» is properly to break silence merely, and «2980» means an extended or random harangue)); by implication, to mean:--ask, bid, boast, call, describe, give out, name, put forth, say(-ing, on), shew, speak, tell, utter.

G3006.def: apparently a primary word; smooth, i.e. "level":--smooth.

G3007.def: a primary verb; to leave, i.e. (intransitively or passively) to fail or be absent:--be destitute (wanting), lack.

G3008.def: from «3011»; to be a public servant, i.e. (by analogy) to perform religious or charitable functions (worship, obey, relieve):--minister.

G3009.def: from «3008»; public function (as priest ("liturgy") or almsgiver):--ministration(-try), service.

G3010.def: from the same as «3008»; functional publicly ("liturgic"); i.e. beneficient:--ministering.

G3011.def: from a derivative of «2992» and «2041»; a public servant, i.e. a functionary in the Temple or Gospel, or (genitive case) a worshipper (of God) or benefactor (of man):--minister(-ed).

G3012.def: of Latin origin; a "linen" cloth, i.e. apron:--towel.

G3014.def: from the same as «3013»; scaliness, i.e. "leprosy":--leprosy.

G3015.def: from the same as «3014»; scaly, i.e. leprous (a leper):--leper.

G3016.et: neuter of a derivative of the same as (3013)
G3016.def: neuter of a derivative of the same as «3013»; something scaled (light), i.e. a small coin:--mite.

G3017.def: of Hebrew origin («03878»); Levi, the name of three Israelites:--Levi. Compare «3018».

G3018.def: a form of «3017»; Lewis (i.e. Levi), a Christian:--Levi.

G3019.def: from «3017»; a Levite, i.e. descendant of Levi:--Levite.

G3020.def: from «3019»; Levitic, i.e. relating to the Levites:--Levitical.

G3025.def: apparently a primary word; a trough, i.e. wine-vat:--winepress.

G3026.def: apparently a primary word; twaddle, i.e. an incredible story:--idle tale.

G3027.def: from leizomai (to plunder); a brigand:--robber, thief.

G3029.def: of uncertain affinity; much (adverbially):--exceeding, great(-ly), sore, very (+ chiefest).

G3030.def: of foreign origin («03828»); the incense-tree, i.e. (by implication) incense itself:--frankincense.

G3031.def: from «3030»; frankincense, i.e. (by extension) a censer for burning it:--censer.

G3032.def: of Latin origin; a Roman freedman:--Libertine.

G3033.def: probably from «3047»; Libye, a region of Africa:--Libya.

G3035.def: from «3037»; stony, i.e. made of stone:--of stone.

G3036.def: from a compound of «3037» and «906»; to throw stones, i.e. lapidate:--stone, cast stones.

G3037.def: apparently a primary word; a stone (literally or figuratively):--(mill-, stumbling-)stone.

G3038.def: from «3037» and a derivative of «4766»; stone-strewed, i.e. a tessellated mosaic on which the Roman tribunal was placed:--Pavement.

G3039.et: from likmos, the equivalent of liknon (a winnowing fan or basket)
G3039.def: from likmos, the equivalent of liknon (a winnowing fan or basket); to winnow, i.e. (by analogy), to triturate:--grind to powder.

G3040.def: apparently a primary word; a harbor:--haven. Compare «2568».

G3041.et: probably from (3040) (through the idea of nearness of shore)
G3041.def: probably from «3040» (through the idea of nearness of shore); a pond (large or small):--lake.

G3042.et: probably from (3007) (through the idea of destitution)
G3042.def: probably from «3007» (through the idea of destitution); a scarcity of food:--dearth, famine, hunger.

G3043.def: probably a primary word; flax, i.e. (by implication) "linen":--linen.

G3046.def: of Latin origin (libra); a pound in weight:--pound.

G3047.def: probably from leibo (to pour a "libation"); the south(- west) wind (as bringing rain, i.e. (by extension) the south quarter):--southwest.

G3048.def: from «3056» (in the commercial sense); a contribution:--collection, gathering.

G3049.def: middle voice from «3056»; to take an inventory, i.e. estimate (literally or figuratively):--conclude, (ac-)count (of), + despise, esteem, impute, lay, number, reason, reckon, suppose, think (on).

G3053.def: from «3049»; computation, i.e. (figuratively) reasoning (conscience, conceit):--imagination, thought.

G3054.def: from a compound of «3056» and «3164»; to be disputatious (on trifles):--strive about words.

G3055.def: from the same as «3054»; disputation about trifles ("logomachy"):--strife of words.

G3056.def: from «3004»; something said (including the thought); by implication, a topic (subject of discourse), also reasoning (the mental faculty) or motive; by extension, a computation; specially, (with the article in John) the Divine Expression (i.e. Christ):--account, cause, communication, × concerning, doctrine, fame, × have to do, intent, matter, mouth, preaching, question, reason, + reckon, remove, say(-ing), shew, × speaker, speech, talk, thing, + none of these things move me, tidings, treatise, utterance, word, work.

G3060.def: from loidos (mischief); abusive, i.e. a blackguard:--railer, reviler.

G3061.def: of uncertain affinity; a plague (literally, the disease, or figuratively, a pest):--pestilence(-t).

G3062.et: masculine plural of a derivative of (3007)
G3062.def: masculine plural of a derivative of «3007»; remaining ones:--other, which remain, remnant, residue, rest.

G3063.et: neuter singular of the same as (3062)
G3063.def: neuter singular of the same as «3062»; something remaining (adverbially):--besides, finally, furthermore, (from) henceforth, moreover, now, + it remaineth, then.

G3064.et: genitive case singular of the same as (3062)
G3064.def: genitive case singular of the same as «3062»; remaining time:--from henceforth.

G3065.def: contracted from Latin Lucanus; Lucas, a Christian:--Lucas, Luke.

G3066.def: of Latin origin; illuminative; Lucius, a Christian:--Lucius.

G3068.def: a primary verb; to bathe (the whole person; whereas «3538» means to wet a part only, and «4150» to wash, cleanse garments exclusively):--wash.

G3069.def: of Hebrew origin («03850»); Lydda (i.e. Lod), a place in Palestine:--Lydda.

G3070.et: properly, feminine of Ludios [of foreign origin] (a Lydian, in Asia Minor)
G3070.def: properly, feminine of Ludios (of foreign origin) (a Lydian, in Asia Minor); Lydia, a Christian woman: -Lydia.

G3071.def: perhaps remotely from «3074»; Lycaonia, a region of Asia Minor:--Lycaonia.

G3072.def: adverb from a derivative of «3071»; Lycaonistically, i.e. in the language of the Lycaonians:--in the speech of Lycaonia.

G3073.def: probably remotely from «3074»; Lycia, a province of Asia Minor:--Lycia.

G3074.et: perhaps akin to the base of (3022) (from the whitish hair)
G3074.def: perhaps akin to the base of «3022» (from the whitish hair); a wolf:--wolf.

G3075.et: middle voice from a probably derivative of (3089) (meaning filth)
G3075.def: middle voice from a probably derivative of «3089» (meaning filth); properly, to soil, i.e. (figuratively) insult (maltreat):--make havock of.

G3076.def: from «3077»; to distress; reflexively or passively, to be sad:--cause grief, grieve, be in heaviness, (be) sorrow(-ful), be (make) sorry.

G3077.def: apparently a primary word; sadness:--grief, grievous, + grudgingly, heaviness, sorrow.

G3078.def: from «3080» and ania (trouble); grief-dispelling; Lysanias, a governor of Abilene:--Lysanias.

G3079.def: of uncertain affinity; Lysias, a Roman:--Lysias.

G3080.def: from «3089»; a loosening, i.e. (specially), divorce:--to be loosed.

G3081.et: third person singular present indicative active of a derivative of a compound of (3080) and (5056)
G3081.def: third person singular present indicative active of a derivative of a compound of «3080» and «5056»; impersonally, it answers the purpose, i.e. is advantageous:--it is better.

G3082.def: of uncertain origin; Lystra, a place in Asia Minor:--Lystra.

G3083.def: from «3089»; something to loosen with, i.e. a redemption price (figuratively, atonement):--ransom.

G3088.def: from the base of «3022»; a portable lamp or other illuminator (literally or figuratively):--candle, light.

G3089.def: a primary verb; to "loosen" (literally or figuratively):--break (up), destroy, dissolve, (un-)loose, melt, put off. Compare «4486».

G3090.def: of uncertain origin; Lois, a Christian woman:--Lois.

G3091.def: of Hebrew origin («03876»); Lot, a patriarch:--Lot.

G3092.def: probably of Hebrew origin; Maath, an Israelite:--Maath.

G3093.def: of Chaldee origin (compare «04026»); the tower; Magdala (i.e. Migdala), a place in Palestine:--Magdala.

G3094.def: feminine of a derivative of «3093»; a female Magdalene, i.e. inhabitant of Magdala:--Magdalene.

G3097.def: of foreign origin («07248»); a Magian, i.e. Oriental scientist; by implication, a magician:--sorcerer, wise man.

G3098.def: of Hebrew origin («04031»); Magog, a foreign nation, i.e. (figuratively) an Antichristian party:--Magog.

G3099.def: of Hebrew origin («04080»); Madian (i.e. Midian), a region of Arabia:--Madian.
